title: Platform implementation mapping
description: Layer 1 schema for one platform manifest extensions/implementations/ fragment: the platform's own implementation rows for a single component, merged into that component's `implementations` array. See spec/manifest.md#extensionsimplementations.

component.description: Name of the component (foundation or platform-local) whose `implementations` this fragment refines.

implementations.description: Rows to upsert (implementation objects) or remove (`op: "remove"` selectors), applied in order.

removeEntry.description: Removes every existing row of the component whose fields equal each selector field given here.
